title: The Spring of Wisdom
wikitext:
{{Hatnote|This article is about the [[Shrine Quest]] in {{BotW}}. For other uses, see [[Spring of Wisdom (Disambiguation)]].}} {{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW The Spring of Wisdom.png |caption= |type= Shrine |game= BotW |giver= [[Medda]] |location= Hateno Village |prereq= |reward= [[Jitan Sa'mi Shrine]] |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|The Spring of Wisdom||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Shrine Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|The Spring of Wisdom}}
{{Color BotW|Shrine Quest|Hateno Village}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== In [[Hateno Village]], [[Link]] can speak to [[Medda]], who states there is not much to see in their town.{{Cite|Hey! Traveler, right? I could tell. Well, there's not a whole lot to see in this village, but knock yourself out.|Medda|BotW}} When Link presses further, Medda shares that there is a [[Kochi Dye Shop|dye shop]] in town,{{Cite|[Nothing of interest?] Well... "Nothing" might be going a little bit overboard... We do have a {{Color BotW|Blue|dye shop}}. I don't think they have one of those in other towns.|Medda|BotW}} though he also points out [[Mount Lanayru]] to the north.{{Cite|We also have {{Color BotW|Blue|Mount Lanayru}} way up to the north. See it?|Medda|BotW}} At Link's confusion, Medda explains that the [[Spring of Wisdom]], where [[Princess Zelda|Zelda]] purified herself, is on top of the mountain.{{Cite|[Mount Lanayru?] Yeah, {{Color BotW|Blue|Mount Lanayru}}'s interesting... The {{Color BotW|Red|Spring of Wisdom}} the princess of {{Color BotW|Blue|Hyrule}} used for the purification is said to be somewhere on that mountain.|Medda|BotW}} Medda suspects that the [[Royal Family of Hyrule]] left a treasure at the Spring of Wisdom.{{Cite|A special fountain? That the princess had to endure hardship to visit? I bet the royal family left a treasure there! ...Well, at least maybe they could've. I would've if I was a royal.|Medda|BotW}} Since Mount Lanayru is covered in [[Ice]], Medda thinks it is unlikely anyone would be able to find out.{{Cite|Anyway, {{Color BotW|Blue|Mount Lanayru}} is a mysterious place, and it's engulfed in ice. If there IS treasure, no one's getting it.|Medda|BotW}} However, he encourages Link to explore up there if he has the opportunity.{{Cite|Well...if you have some time to kill, feel free to have a look around up there.|Medda|BotW}} When he finishes speaking, the [[Shrine Quest]] begins.{{Note|It is possible to immediately complete this Shrine Quest by climbing Mount Lanayru, rescuing Naydra, and unlocking Jitan Sa'mi Shrine before speaking to Medda.}} On top of Mount Lanayru, Link can find [[Malice Naydra]] curled around the [[Spring of Wisdom Statue]], which is the Spring of Wisdom's [[Goddess Statue]]. Through the Statue, [[Hylia]] congratulates Link for finding the Spring.{{Cite|You have done well to find your way to this spring.|Spring of Wisdom Statue|BotW}} She explains that [[Naydra]] is a spirit that has overlooked the land of [[Hyrule Kingdom|Hyrule]] for ages.{{Cite|You who have overcome numerous trials and obtained the {{Color BotW|Blue|Spirit Orbs}}... The one you see before you is an attendant to the {{Color BotW|Blue|Spring of Wisdom}}. This is {{Color BotW|Blue|Naydra}}, the blue spirit of Lanayru. This servant of the Goddess has looked over the spirits of this land for ages, unknown to the world of man.|Spring of Wisdom Statue|BotW}} Unfortunately, it has become corrupted by [[Calamity Ganon]]'s [[Malice]].{{Cite|However, the dreaded Malice unleashed by Calamity Ganon has possessed its body and reduced it to this state.|Spring of Wisdom Statue|BotW}} Therefore, Hylia tasks Link with purging the Malice from Naydra.{{Cite|You who have received the Spirit Orbs... Free {{Color BotW|Blue|Naydra}} from this Malice. Show what your power can achieve!|Spring of Wisdom Statue|BotW}} The [[Glowing Eyeball]] on Malice Naydra's head then opens. When Link shoots one of the Glowing Eyeballs, Malice Naydra will begin to fly above the Spring of Wisdom. Using its [[Updraft]]s, Link can reach the [[Dragon]] to continue shooting at the Malice. Malice Naydra will make its way towards [[Naydra Snowfield]]. After all of the Glowing Eyeballs have been defeated, Naydra will return to its white and blue appearance and fly to the Spring of Wisdom.{{Cite|You freed {{Color BotW|Red|Naydra}}, the guardian dragon of the Mount Lanayru spring, from the darkness that had overcome it.|Adventure Log|BotW}} Hylia congratulates Link for freeing Naydra.{{Cite|Thanks to your efforts, {{Color BotW|Blue|Naydra}}, the spirit of Mount Lanayru, has been freed from the grips of an {{Color BotW|Red|evil power}}.|Spring of Wisdom Statue|BotW}} She instructs Link to shoot Naydra with one last [[Arrow]], thereby freeing the Dragon.{{Cite|But a single ceremony remains. Now... Loose your arrow through the body of {{Color BotW|Blue|Naydra}} to free the spirit of this region!|Spring of Wisdom Statue|BotW}} When he does, one of [[Naydra's Scale]] will drop right in front of Link as it flies away.{{Cite|When {{Color BotW|Red|Naydra}} soared away into the heavens, it left behind {{Color BotW|Red|Naydra's scale}}.|Adventure Log|BotW}}{{Cite|That is the spirit {{Color BotW|Blue|Naydra's scale}}. It fell when your arrow struck. It serves as proof of the courage you received from the one who served the spring since ancient times.|Spring of Wisdom Statue|BotW}} Hylia instructs Link to drop it in the Spring.{{Cite|Come... Offer a {{Color BotW|Blue|scale}} from the blue spirit {{Color BotW|Blue|Naydra}} to the {{Color BotW|Blue|Spring of Wisdom}}.|Spring of Wisdom Statue|BotW}} When this is done, the door to [[Jitan Sa'mi Shrine]] will open, and Hylia will tell Link to go forward.{{Cite|Your path has shown itself. Now go forth.|Spring of Wisdom Statue|BotW}} Afterwards, the Shrine Quest will be completed. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | Medda, a resident of Hateno Village, told you that there is a {{Color BotW|Red|Spring of Wisdom}} somewhere on Mount Lanayru, which towers to the north of the village. The story goes that long ago, a princess used that spring for a purification ceremony.

Moreover, there are rumors of a fantastic treasure hidden in the {{Color BotW|Red|spring}}. |- | 2 | You found no treasure but instead discovered {{Color BotW|Red|Naydra}}, the Spring of Wisdom's guardian spirit, who has been overtaken by darkness.

Break through the evil force possessing {{Color BotW|Red|Naydra}} to set this great spirit free! |- | 3 | You freed {{Color BotW|Red|Naydra}}, the guardian dragon of the Mount Lanayru spring, from the darkness that had overcome it.

When {{Color BotW|Red|Naydra}} soared away into the heavens, it left behind {{Color BotW|Red|Naydra's scale}}. |- | Complete | When you tossed {{Color BotW|Red|Naydra's scale}} into the Spring of Wisdom, an ancient shrine appeared.

Freed of the shackles of evil, Naydra flew away in peace. }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Jitan Sa'mi Shrine.png|Jitan Sa'mi Shrine ==See Also== {{See Also| * Hateno Village * Jitan Sa'mi Shrine * Medda * Mount Lanayru * Spring of Wisdom * The Serpent's Jaws * The Spring of Power }} {{Notes}} {{Ref}} {{Categories |shrine-quests= BotW }}
